title: Pace band planner
weather_null_policy: null band / token null — never invent
notes: Empirical pace-band planner from C3 matched cohorts on full features_v2 (n_rows_used=2512860). Ability 30-min bands × sex × course; wristband target-finish → first-half/base_pace IQR. Fallback probe stage_counts={'exact': 3686, 'widen_ability_pm1': 108, 'drop_sex': 194, 'widen_ability_pm2': 12}. Maps to S2+S1. Weather mostly null (honest). Melbourne elev N/A.
method: Stream features_v2.parquet column subsets; filter valid_splits & finite finish_time. Annotate with gap_substrate.cohorts.assign_cohort_columns (ability→pb_recent_int→finish_time, course=city, weather from wx_* with null band when missing). Aggregate finish/split/pace quantiles by ability_band×sex and ×course; wristband table = finish-time 30-min band×sex → empirical first-half/base_pace IQR. Document lookup_comparators fallback rates on reservoir sample (n_queries≈4000). No race_records writes. No invented elev/weather.
caveats: Name-matching identity not required for corpus planner (aggregates over finishers).
Weather nulls honest: features_v2 built with --no-weather; weather_band token=null; never invent weather.
Melbourne elev N/A — P1 does not invent elev; elev not used in pace-band tables.
C3 matched peers via gap_substrate.cohorts only: ability 30-min bands x course x weather; min_n=30; fallback exact→drop_weather→drop_sex→widen_ability ±1…±2 (course held).
Sparse cells (n < 30) omitted from recommendation tables.
implementation: Streaming row-group column-subset from features_v2; gap_substrate.cohorts.assign_cohort_columns + lookup_comparators + cohort_size_table; gc between groups; no race_records writes.
answer_prose: Empirical pace-band planner on 2,512,860 valid finishers (of 3,167,990 features). 31 ability×sex cells and 467 ability×sex×course cells with n≥30; 30 wristband target-finish×sex cells. Corpus-weighted mean positive_split≈0.115; sustained slowdown rate≈29.8%. Example ability band a210 M: n=476,153, finish p10/p50/p90 = 214.4/228.7/239.9 min; recommended first-half pace 4.981–5.423 min/km (IQR of peers); mean positive_split=0.088, sustained slowdown rate=24.2%. Wristband (target a240 M, n=362,827): suggested first-half 5.472–5.866 min/km; base_pace 5.460–5.836 min/km. C3 matched-peer fallbacks (min_n=30, reservoir probe n_queries=4000): exact 92.2% (n=3686); drop_sex 4.9% (n=194); widen_ability_pm1 2.7% (n=108); widen_ability_pm2 0.3% (n=12). Weather band null for 100.0% of used rows (honest; never invented). Maps to S2+S1.
methodology_prose: P1 uses ONLY gap_substrate.cohorts on features_v2.parquet: assign_cohort_columns bands ability (ability→pb_recent_int→finish_time, width=30 min), course=city, weather from wx_* (null band when missing — features_v2 built --no-weather). Tables: finish p10/p50/p90, mean positive_split & split_ratio, sustained slowdown/severity rates, and recommended early-pace = empirical IQR of pace_first_half / base_pace by ability_band×sex (+ course). Wristband maps target finish 30-min band×sex to peer first-half/base_pace ranges. Matched-peer engine lookup_comparators fallback order exact→drop_weather→drop_sex→widen_ability ±1…±2 (course held); min_n=30. Fallback rates from reservoir sample (n=25000, queries=4000). Sparse cells n<30 omitted. Melbourne elev N/A (not invented). No race_records writes. n_rows_used=2,512,860.
